10: Who is the man that desires life? Loves days to see good? (Psalms 34)

A basic spiritual foundation: One must seek peace. There should be peace between Israel. There should be peace between an individual and his distinct characteristics. That is to say, one should not be divided in his characteristics. And in all a persons various experiences, he should not distinguish between the good and the bad. Rather he should find within all experiences Hashem, may He be blessed. That is, “In Hashem I will say a word of praise; in Elokim I will say a word of praise” (Psalms 56).

To the extent that one may find Hashem, may he be blessed in the good and the bad, and by means of the Torah which is called shalom, as it is written, “All its paths are peace” (Proverbs 3), and by means of the Tzaddikim/Righteous/Saints who are similarly called a “covenant of peace”, on account of all of this, one can love peace in any place, whether good or bad, and may be peace between Israel, and one may love the other.
